verses.1: And all the tribes of the Israelites gathered together. They set up the tent of the meeting there. The land was covered with dust in front of them.
verses.2: And it was ordered by God that the sons of Israel should not divide their inheritance into seven parts.
verses.3: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Do not be discouraged before entering into the land that the LORD your God has given you as a possession.”
verses.4: I will give you three men to be rulers over the land. I will send them out into the land, and they will govern it according to their own abilities. Then they will come to me.
verses.5: And they were divided into seven parts. Yehuda stood on his border, while Boaz stood on their borders from Tsafon.
verses.6: And you shall divide the land into seven parts. Then you shall bring it before me, and I will give you a reward in front of our God, Jehovah.
verses.7: For the Levites have no share among you, as it is the inheritance of Jehovah’s people. Gad, Reuben, and half of the tribe of Manasseh took their inheritance from beyond the Jordan, from the east side, which Moses, the servant of Jehovah, gave them.
verses.8: And the people stood up and went away. Joshua commanded them to go and write down the details of that land. He said, “Go and write down everything about that land. Then come back to me.” And so, I will give you a copy of it before the LORD.
verses.9: And the people went forth and passed through the land. They divided it into seven parts, according to the number of names on the list. Then they went to Joshua, to the camp of Shechem.
verses.10: And Joshua divided the land among the children of Israel, according to their portions.
verses.11: And Gomer’s sons, Benyamin’s sons, went to their families. Their borders extended between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.
verses.12: And they had a boundary line running from the Jordan River, up to the hill of Jericho. This boundary line continued further up to Mount Yamah. Their territory extended from the desert until the city of Be’er Oan.
verses.13: And from there, the border went on to Luzah. Luzah is a mountain range. It’s also called Bet El. Then the border continued down to Ader, along the mountain that faces towards Beit Horon.
verses.14: And let us describe the border. It extends towards the sea. It is raised above the mountain that lies on the face of Bet Horon. Its exits lead to a forest. This is the city of the sons of Judah. That’s the area around the sea.
verses.15: And from the edge of the forests, a border appeared on land. Then it extended towards the sea, towards the waters of Neftoach.
verses.16: And the border descended to the edge of the mountain that was located on the face of Gei Ben-Hinom. This mountain was situated at the foot of the steep cliffs of Raphaim Tsafonah. Then Gei Ben-Hinom continued its descent towards the peak of Haybusi Negevah. Finally, it reached the edge of Ein Rogel.
verses.17: And he looked ahead, and a ray of sunlight came out. It then went towards the valleys that lie above the mountains. Then, a cloud of dust rose from there.
verses.18: And he went over to the hill opposite the sunset. Then, the darkness covered the area.
verses.19: And they crossed the border to Ketef Beit Haggalah, which is located in the northern part of the region. From there, they continued their journey along the border towards the Sea of Salt, all the way to the edge of the Jordan River. This was a steeply sloping border.
verses.20: And the Jordan River will be taken away from them in front of Kedemah. This will be the territory of the sons of Benyamin, around their settlements.
verses.21: And there were cities belonging to the sons of Benyamin, along with their families. Those cities were Jericho, Bet-hagga, and Emek Kitziv.
verses.22: And in the house of Arva, and in the fields, and in the house of El.
verses.23: And the oxen, and the sheep, and the goats.
verses.24: And they destroyed the towns of Ammon and Ahab; they also destroyed twenty-two cities and their fortresses.
verses.26: And the predictions, the misunderstandings, and the schemes.
verses.28: And the territory of Elef and Yevusi is Jerusalem, with its surrounding towns and their courtyards. This is the territory of the sons of Benjamin, for their families.
